warnings: volume_pct_of_consumption=47 is computed: 1,792M gallons / 3,800M gallons (2013 consumption estimate); not explicitly stated as a percentage in the filing.
Delta acquired Monroe Energy (Trainer refinery near Philadelphia, PA) in June 2012 for $180M from Phillips 66; refinery segment reported separately alongside airline segment.
Monroe refinery production commenced September 2012; Superstorm Sandy negatively impacted Q4 2012 startup; refinery recorded $63M net loss in Q4 2012.
FY2012 net fuel hedge losses were $66M ($81M mark-to-market + $15M AOCI reclassification gain). All fuel contracts are not-designated since June 2011.
Refinery capacity: 185,000 barrels per day. BP is primary crude oil supplier. Non-jet-fuel products exchanged with Phillips 66 and BP for jet fuel.
